record.label: Logical qubits times T count for the simulation
record.statement: Appendix H.4 reports $Q=6{,}033$ logical qubits and a spacetime cost $Q\cdot\mathcal{T}=605{,}980{,}010{,}227{,}389$ for one femtosecond of evolution. The time-evolution budget excludes initial-state preparation and observable readout, as in the baseline.
record.boundary: The budget in Appendix H.4 evaluates to $100{,}444{,}225{,}133$ T gates. Lean proves an exact equality when it multiplies that budget by $Q=6{,}033$ and an inequality when it bounds the structural T count of the circuit itself.
